purpose: Frozen input-to-expected-output regression vectors for later runnable tests.
executionStatus: Not executed; no implementation or test runner exists for these vectors yet.
verificationNotes: Expected results were independently checked against the draft contracts, not produced by an implementation.
The output vocabulary is implementation-neutral and does not prescribe a runtime API schema.
Unicode source data uses JSON escapes for U+1D400; the escaped pair decodes to one supplementary character occupying two UTF-16 code units.
These vectors must not be presented as passing tests or as coverage of every contract case.

cases.name: Changing unit case must not produce sourced evidence

expected.removalReason: Required evidence quote is absent from the canonical source-text snapshot.

verificationNotes: The source contains lowercase m followed by uppercase W; the quote replaces lowercase m with uppercase M.
Case folding would erase the difference, so it is excluded even if all remaining characters match.

cases.name: A supplementary Unicode prefix shifts UTF-16 offsets
verificationNotes: U+1D400 occupies UTF-16 indices 0 and 1, the following space occupies index 2, and grant occupies indices 3 through 7.
Python-style code-point range [2, 7) must become UTF-16 range [3, 8) at the adapter boundary.
Applying [2, 7) unchanged to the UTF-16 snapshot would select a leading space and omit the final t.

cases.name: Canonical evidence survives unavailable viewer alignment

expected.viewerNote: Exact phrase not located in document view

verificationNotes: Applications close on followed by one space has 22 UTF-16 code units; 30 November 2026 has 16, giving [22, 38).
Missing viewer alignment prevents highlighting; it does not make a present canonical quote absent.

cases.name: Absent canonical evidence removes the sourced candidate

expected.removalReason: Required evidence quote is absent from the canonical source-text snapshot.

verificationNotes: The canonical snapshot contains 30 November 2026 and contains no 15 December 2026 passage.
